violations.reason: The coverage audit pipeline stage claims zero gaps ('gaps': []) and fakes success without actually verifying or implementing the underlying client brief requirements for department and course-based access control, nor does it address the CI test failures on 401s.

In AuthController.performMoodleRoleSync, when userService.updateRoleAtomically returns 0 (indicating a concurrent modification failure), it silently swallows this real failure and falls back to an unguarded jdbcTemplate.update, masking the concurrency error and faking success instead of explicitly throwing a concurrency exception.

In JwtTokenProvider.extractJsonValue, when a key is not found, it returns an empty string (a default value) instead of explicitly failing. Furthermore, it swallows exceptions and returns an empty string, which silently masks malformed JSON payloads and fakes success.

The claimed integration between the backend and Moodle LMS is unwired; AuthController.performMoodleRoleSync claims to sync Moodle roles but actually just reads from the local 'users' table without invoking any external Moodle OAuth2/OIDC/LTI endpoint, silently dropping the external data flow.
